review_walkthrough: Open two libraries; highlight in each; Obsidian: give each its own folder and sync; add your own text to a note; sync again: text kept; try the other library's folder: refused.
Remove a library, point another at its folder: refused; re-add it: its export continues.
Quit/restart: each library's notes and text intact.
